potm.heading: Project of the month.
potm.title: Brenda’s Kuhinjira
potm.story: They did not have a perfect plan. They just had each other, a vision, and a love that refused to be ordinary. From the first conversation to the final vow, every moment between them carried weight, the kind you feel in your chest before you can explain it in words. And that is exactly how Brenda’s kuhinjira became our Project of the Month.
